name: Angular CW
description: The original direction. A square C beside an angular W.
tradeoff: The fine W loses definition at the smallest sizes.

name: Lowercase cw
description: A compact lowercase monogram drawn from Inter.
strength: Direct, readable, and consistent with the app typography.
tradeoff: A typographic mark has a more familiar silhouette.

name: Console C
description: A cut-corner C with a short command line inside it.
strength: A bold silhouette with a clear coding reference.
tradeoff: The C carries the name; the W is absent.

name: Parallel
description: Three paths converge into a shared workspace.
tradeoff: Abstract; needs the wordmark while the brand is new.

name: Workspace
description: A compact window with a project rail and two work panes.
tradeoff: More descriptive of the category than unique to cw-code.

name: Folded W
description: A heavy W built from a continuous angular ribbon.
strength: Strong at small sizes and easy to recognize by shape.
tradeoff: Emphasizes workspace rather than the full CW initials.
